'''Tarantula Web''' is obtained by killing the {{MobSprite|Tarantula Broodfather}}. It is a {{Odds|guaranteed}} drop, and is used to make various items. It can also be dropped by [[Spider Slayer]] [[Tarantula Broodfather#Minibosses|minibosses]].

Many high-level items are crafted with {{Item|Tarantula Silk}}, which must itself be crafted with Tarantula Webs and {{Item|Enchanted Flint}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Tarantula Broodfather ===
'''Tarantula Webs''' are {{O|G}} drops from the {{MobSprite|Tarantula Broodfather}}. They amount dropped varies based on the tier of the boss.

;Amounts
* {{Stier|1}}: 2-4x
* {{Stier|2}}: 4-8x
* {{Stier|3}}: 16-32x
* {{Stier|4}}: 32-48x
* {{Stier|5}}: 64x
